device_path.description: Path to the GPS device (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/ttyACM0); must be readable/writable by the user.

protocol.description: Protocol name to use for receiver communication (e.g., 'garmin', 'lowrance', 'magellan'); consult 'show protocols' command output.

receiver_brand.description: Receiver manufacturer override: 'garmin', 'lowrance', or 'magellan'; only supported for Garmin at present.

prefs_file.description: Path to an alternative preferences file to read instead of the default user preferences file.

log_communication.description: If true, create a logfile of low-level communication in the GPSMan user directory.
